exercises.instructionEn: Read the following paragraphs and match them to the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi xatboshilarni o'qing va rasmlarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har xatboshida 5 ta belgi bor: yosh, bo'y, gavda, soch, yuz.
Rasmga moslashda ENG ANIQ belgidan boshlang:

  • Kim — 'slanting eyes' (qiyiq ko'z)
  • Ian — 'a beard and a moustache' (soqol va mo'ylov)
  • Robert — 'seventy years old' (eng keksa)
  • Peter — 'tall and well-built' (baland va baquvvat)

Bitta noyob belgi topilsa, qolganini tekshirish oson.

answers.descUz: Peter — 20 yosh, baland va baquvvat, kalta jingalak soch

answers.descUz: Kim — 22 yosh, past va nozik, uzun tekis soch, qiyiq ko'z

answers.descUz: Robert — 70 yosh, keksa, kalta oq soch, ingichka lab, katta burun

answers.descUz: Ian — 52 yosh, o'rta yoshli, o'rta bo'yli va semiz, kulrang tekis soch, soqol va mo'ylov

exercises.instructionEn: Read the paragraphs again and fill in the tables, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatboshilarni qayta o'qing va jadvallarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvalda 7 qator bor. Har qatorga matndan mos ma'lumot yoziladi.

'Other Characteristics' (boshqa belgilar) — matnda alohida aytilgan,
boshqa qatorlarga sig'maydigan narsa:
  • Kim   — slanting eyes
  • Ian   — a beard and a moustache
  • Robert — (matnda qo'shimcha belgi yo'q)
  • Peter — (matnda qo'shimcha belgi yo'q)

commonMistake.wrong: Hair: 'short white' · Nose: 'largue' · Height: 'medium heigth' · Other: 'used cap'
commonMistake.whyUz:
To'rt xato:
1) Soch — matnda 'grey straight hair' (kulrang tekis), 'short white' emas. Bu Robertning sochi.
2) 'largue' — imlo xatosi. To'g'risi: LARGE.
3) 'heigth' — harflar o'rni almashgan. To'g'risi: HEIGHT.
4) 'used cap' — matnda bunday narsa yo'q. To'g'risi: A BEARD AND A MOUSTACHE.
Matnda 'Robert is SEVENTY years old' — ya'ni 70, 60 emas. Sonlarni diqqat bilan o'qing: seventy (70) va sixty (60) o'xshash eshitiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Cover the texts, look at the pictures and the tables and describe each person.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni yoping, rasmlar va jadvallarga qarab har bir odamni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvaldagi 7 qator 5 ta gapga aylanadi:
  1) ISM + is + YOSH + years old. He/She is + yosh guruhi.
  2) He/She is + BO'Y + and + GAVDA.
  3) He/She has got + SOCH + hair.
  4) He/She has got + LAB + lips and a + BURUN + nose.
  5) He/She has got + BOSHQA BELGI. (agar bo'lsa)

DIQQAT: bo'y va gavda uchun BE, soch va yuz uchun HAVE GOT.
modelAnswers: Peter is twenty years old. He is young. He is tall and well-built. He has got short curly hair. He has got full lips and a wide flattish nose.
Kim is twenty-two years old. She is young. She is short and slim. She has got long straight hair. She has got full lips, slanting eyes and a small nose.
Robert is seventy years old. He is old. He is short and slim. He has got short white hair. He has got thin lips and a big nose.
Ian is fifty-two years old. He is middle-aged. He is of medium height and he is fat. He has got grey straight hair, a beard and a moustache. He has got a large nose and full lips.

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions and answers as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROQDA FE'L EGADAN OLDIN KELADI — bu betdagi barcha xato shundan.

  'Is your car new?'  — TO'G'RI (fe'l birinchi)
  'Your car is new?'  — XATO (bu tasdiq gap tartibi)

JAVOBDA to'g'ri OLMOSHNI tanlang:
  • mashina haqida  → IT ('it's very old')
  • erkak haqida    → HE ('he's from Turkey')
  • o'zingiz haqida → I ('I'm from Brazil')

MAMLAKAT oldidan 'from' SHART:
  'He's from Turkey' — TO'G'RI
  'It's Turkey'      — XATO (mamlakat — narsa emas, odam undan keladi)

items.prompt: your car / new? → No / very old
items.question: Is your car new?
items.whyUz: 'your car' — narsa (it) → Is. Javobda ham IT.

commonMistake.wrong: 'is you car new' / 'No, I's very old'
commonMistake.whyUz:
Ikki xato:
1) 'you car' — egalik olmoshi kerak: YOUR car. Va gap boshida katta harf: 'Is'.
2) 'I's' degan shakl YO'Q. Mashina — narsa, demak IT'S.

Uch xato:
1) So'roq gap tartibi buzilgan: 'IS HE from...?' bo'lishi kerak, 'He is...' emas.
2) 'from' tushib qolgan. Mamlakat oldidan 'from' SHART.
3) Odam haqida gap ketyapti — IT emas, HE. Va katta harf: Portugal.

wordFormation.introUz: Bu betda imlo xatolari ko'p — shuning uchun yozilishiga alohida e'tibor.

groups.explanationUz: Ba'zi sifatlardan ot yasaladi. Yozilishi o'zgaradi — bu betda aynan shu xato qilingan.
Bir narsani turlicha ayta olish — nutqni boyitadi.
'you' va 'your' ni adashtirmang — biri EGA, ikkinchisi EGALIK.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Tavsif qolipi va so'roq gap tartibi.

patterns.formula: TO'LIQ TAVSIF (5 gap): yosh → bo'y/gavda → soch → yuz → boshqa
patterns.exampleEn: Ian is fifty-two years old. He is middle-aged. He is of medium height and he is fat. He has got grey straight hair, a beard and a moustache. He has got a large nose and full lips.
patterns.exampleUz: Ian ellik ikki yoshda. U o'rta yoshli. U o'rta bo'yli va semiz. Uning kulrang tekis sochi, soqoli va mo'ylovi bor. Katta burni va to'la labi bor.
patterns.explanationUz: Tartib buzilmasin. Bo'y-gavda uchun BE, soch-yuz uchun HAVE GOT.
Bu ibora 'of' bilan keladi — 'He is medium height' ham eshitiladi, lekin 'of' bilan to'g'riroq.

patterns.exampleEn: Is your car new? / Is he from Portugal?
patterns.explanationUz: ENG KO'P XATO shu yerda. Tasdiq gapda 'Your car is new', so'roqda esa 'IS your car new?' — fe'l oldinga chiqadi.

patterns.formula: JAVOB: No, EGA + be + from + MAMLAKAT.
patterns.explanationUz: 'from' TUSHIB QOLMASIN. Va odam haqida bo'lsa 'he/she', narsa haqida bo'lsa 'it'.
